metadata.title: Western Portrait with Layered Scribble Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered square photographic portrait of a young child in traditional Western attire, framed by a wide white border and overlaid with repetitive, shaky, hand-drawn charcoal-style lettering that bleeds across the image boundaries.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the sharp, clean studio portrait and the messy, organic scribbled text.
The red bandana acts as the primary focal point within the muted blue and white palette.
Text layers create a sense of depth, appearing both behind and in front of the subject.
coreInvariants: Vast white negative space surrounding the core image
Subject in Western wear (hat, bandana, denim)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body child subject, centered vertically and horizontally within the inner square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red bandana at the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red bandana, moves to the child's face, then radiates outward following the repetitive text patterns into the white space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white border occupying approximately 60% of the total canvas area.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key overall due to white space, with high saturation reserved only for the central accent color.

letterConstructionRules: Shaky, jittery line quality suggesting a child's handwriting or intentional tremor
Thin, charcoal-like stroke with varying opacity
Small heart shapes used as tittle/dots over letters
Extended descenders and ascenders that overlap other lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'E' with three distinct, slightly disconnected horizontal bars
Lowercase 'q' with a long, looping descender
Lowercase 'i' topped with a small heart

typesetting.density: high in center, sparse at edges

composition.position: layered over and around the central image
composition.relationshipToImage: interacting with the subject, breaking the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single repetitive style used to create texture rather than legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, personal feel of the original texture.
Captures the childlike quality of the letterforms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A centered square photo of a toddler in a white cowboy hat, red bandana, and denim jeans against a mottled blue studio backdrop, surrounded by a wide, clean white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply multiple layers of hand-drawn, shaky charcoal text. The text should repeat the same word multiple times, overlapping itself and the central image, with small hearts as dots over the 'i's. Ensure the text bleeds into the white margin.

verificationChecks: Is the red bandana the most saturated element?
Does the text look hand-drawn rather than typed?
Is the central image a perfect square?
Are there heart shapes integrated into the lettering?

mustAchieve: Authentic charcoal/pencil texture in the lines
Balanced 'messiness' that doesn't obscure the face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text feels jittery and organic.
Check that the red bandana pops against the blue/white.
Verify the text overlaps the border of the square image.
Confirm the subject is a child in Western wear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a clean studio portrait [Subject] with a high-contrast [Border Color] frame, then layer repetitive [Style] hand-lettering that breaks the frame boundaries to create a sense of raw, textured depth.
